title: Is it prime?
prompt: Write is_prime(n) that returns True if n is a prime number (greater than 1 and divisible only by 1 and itself), otherwise False.
hints: A number is NOT prime if some smaller number (other than 1) divides it exactly. How can you test 'divides exactly'?
Check the small cases by hand first: is 0 prime? 1? 2? A negative number? Decide those before the loop.
Plan: return False for n < 2; then try each possible divisor from 2 upwards; if any divides n exactly return False; if none does return True. You only need divisors up to the square root of n.

edge_hints.one: 1 is not a prime number: a prime has exactly two divisors. Handle numbers below 2 before the loop.
edge_hints.zero: 0 and negative numbers are not prime. Handle them before the loop.
edge_hints.negative: Negative numbers are never prime. Handle them before the loop.
